I want to turn NASA data into impactful, interactive solutions. I’m looking for collaborative teammates skilled in UI/UX, GIS/satellite data, astronomy, data science, or full-stack development. Curiosity, creativity, and teamwork matter most. Let’s build something meaningful!
summary:
CHARIZARD is an AI-assisted research discovery platform designed to make NASA's space-combustion research easier to explore, understand and compare.

Using resources from NASA's Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) repository, CHARIZARD organizes information from combustion investigations into a structured research experience. Users can explore experiments based on available parameters such as fuel type, oxygen concentration, airflow, experimental hardware, sensors and measurements.

The platform aims to help researchers discover relevant investigations, compare experimental conditions, and identify areas where available evidence is limited or incomplete. Its AI-assisted research approach is intended to make scientific information easier to navigate while preserving links to original sources for verification.

By connecting existing research with future research questions, CHARIZARD aims to support students, scientists and aerospace engineers working toward safer spacecraft, lunar habitats and future Mars missions.
details:
CHARIZARD — Intelligent Research Discovery for Space Combustion Safety

THE PROBLEM

Fire behaves differently in space environments, where microgravity, atmospheric composition, oxygen concentration and pressure can influence combustion. NASA has conducted several combustion investigations in space, but discovering, navigating and comparing information across different experiments can be challenging. Researchers need a clearer way to explore existing evidence and understand the limitations of available experimental data.

OUR SOLUTION

CHARIZARD is an AI-assisted research discovery platform built around NASA's Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) combustion research resources. It aims to transform investigation information into a structured, searchable and comparable experience.

HOW IT WORKS

Users can explore combustion investigations and examine available experimental parameters, including fuel type, oxygen concentration, airflow, hardware, sensors and measurements. The platform is designed to support investigation filtering, comparison of experimental conditions, scenario-based research discovery and exploration of missing or underrepresented information. AI-assisted functionality can help users navigate relevant scientific information while retaining references to original sources.

CREATIVITY AND INNOVATION

CHARIZARD focuses on connecting scientific data discovery with research-oriented analysis. Instead of treating investigations as isolated records, it encourages users to explore relationships, similarities and differences across experiments. It also distinguishes between conditions that were not tested and information that is simply unavailable, helping avoid unsupported scientific conclusions.

TOOLS AND TECHNOLOGIES

Reactjs, Python, FastAPI, SQLLite, Plotly etc.

INTENDED IMPACT

CHARIZARD aims to help students, researchers and aerospace engineers discover relevant combustion studies more efficiently, understand existing experimental evidence and identify questions for future research. In the long term, it could support research contributing to safer spacecraft, lunar habitats and future Mars missions.

SCIENTIFIC CONSIDERATIONS

The project considers source traceability, experimental differences, missing metadata and the limitations of comparing different combustion systems. It does not treat missing information as proof of a scientific research gap, nor does it claim to replace experimental validation or expert scientific judgment.
